original.value: A dramatic, high-contrast studio portrait of a {argument name="subject gender" default="male"} athlete or model in the visual style of a premium sports drink advertisement, centered and facing straight toward the camera in a tight head-and-shoulders crop. The subject has {argument name="hair style" default="short dark hair brushed back"}, visible ears on both sides, and a rugged lower face with a short beard or stubble. Dress him in a dark zip-up athletic jacket with the zipper centered and visible near the collar. Use an almost entirely black background and extremely low-key lighting, with subtle rim light and soft highlights catching the hair, ears, jawline, shoulders, and jacket texture while most facial features remain swallowed by shadow for a mysterious, intense mood. The image should feel monochrome or nearly monochrome, with deep blacks, muted gray highlights, cinematic contrast, gritty texture, and a sleek commercial sports-brand aesthetic reminiscent of a {argument name="brand style" default="Gatorade"} campaign. Vertical composition, minimalist framing, no text, no logo, no props, no visible environment.

zh-CN.value: 一张戏剧性的高对比度工作室肖像，展示一位{argument name="subject gender" default="male"}运动员或模特，采用高端运动饮料广告的视觉风格，主体居中，直视镜头，采用紧贴头部和肩膀的构图。主体拥有{argument name="hair style" default="short dark hair brushed back"}（向后梳理的深色短发），两侧耳朵可见，下部脸庞轮廓分明，带有短须或胡茬。为他穿着深色拉链运动夹克，拉链居中，靠近衣领处可见。使用几乎全黑的背景和极低的灯光，带有柔和的轮廓光和柔和的高光，捕捉头发、耳朵、下颌线、肩膀和夹克纹理，而大多数面部特征则被阴影吞没，营造出神秘而强烈的氛围。图像应感觉是单色或接近单色的，具有深沉的黑色、柔和的灰色高光、电影般的对比度、粗糙的质感，以及一种精致的商业运动品牌美学，让人联想到{argument name="brand style" default="Gatorade"}（佳得乐）广告系列。垂直构图，极简框架，无文字，无标志，无道具，无可见环境。
